headline: 康斯特勃250週年特展
context: 英國畫家康斯特勃（John Constable）250 週年，名作《乾草車》（The Hay Wain）特展在伊普斯威奇開幕，評論稱它是「氣候危機時代的傑作」。同週還有 Tate Modern 的 Ana Mendieta 大展，以及 Bon Jovi 在聲帶手術後重返麥迪遜廣場花園。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Christchurch Mansion, Ipswich While Britain boils in a heatwave, a new exhibition built around the much-reproduced canvas reminds us of the beauty of the natural world – and what we could lose I first saw John Constable’s 1821 painting The Hay Wain as a postcard with cruise missiles brutally stacked in the wooden cart and pointing at the sky. Peter Kennard’s anti-nuke photomontage is just one of the many parodies and travesties this image of a seemingly eternal rustic Britain keeps provoking. A few months ago, a newspaper cartoon depicted a ballistic missile from Iran speeding through Constable’s painting. But when I visited Ipswich to see its Hay Wain exhibition at the start of the latest heatwave it was the climate making a scorching, ironic comment on this temperate scene. Inside this Tudor house, grey, blue and brown masses of rain-promising cloud hung above Constable’s painted Suffolk fields, dappling them with shade. But outside the grass was straw yellow and the landscape around Dedham Vale and the River Stour, where Constable was born and in which The Hay Wain and many more of his works lovingly linger, appeared to have been blowtorched into oblivion. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Hay Wain: Walking Constable’s Landscape review – a masterpiece for the climate crisis age

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Tate Modern hosts a major exhibition of Ana Mendieta, Constable turns 250 and the accidental beauty captured by unattended online cameras – all in your weekly dispatch Ana Mendieta Neolithic monuments inspired this Cuban-born American artist to create her ephemeral, raw, poetic works that embrace nature in a truly original way. • Tate Modern, London, from 15 July to 17 January Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Madison Square Garden, New York City After vocal cord surgery, Jon Bon Jovi and band make a sturdy return with hit-packed show This time last week, the scene in and around Madison Square Garden was an entirely different affair thanks to a certain superstar’s wedding of the century . It’s back to regular programming tonight: New York Knicks regalia is hanging from the rafters again, and music has once again taken center stage as fans file in for Bon Jovi ’s Forever tour. The band’s nine dates at the arena this month mark their first outing in four years, after frontman Jon Bon Jovi underwent major reconstructive surgery on his vocal cords in 2022. (UK dates, including London’s Wembley Stadium, follow later this summer.) The extended break seems to be on the band’s mind as the singer begins with a taped message where he describes a recurring dream in which he holds a spotlight. “In that beam of light I saw your smiling faces. I saw the memories, I saw the songs come to life,” he says. “Our reward for all of this? We get to stand in the reflection of that light.” Continue reading...
sources.title: Bon Jovi review – rockers make a surprisingly poignant return to the stage

thread_text:
藝文一週。康斯特勃（John Constable）250 週年，名作《乾草車》（The Hay Wain）特展於伊普斯威奇 Christchurch Mansion 開幕——英國正值熱浪，評論稱這幅 1821 年的風景畫是「氣候危機時代的傑作」，提醒我們可能失去什麼。Tate Modern 推出古巴裔美國藝術家 Ana Mendieta 大展。Bon Jovi 在主唱聲帶手術後重返紐約麥迪遜廣場花園，演出被評「意外地動人」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 至 11 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
藝文這邊，一週三件事。英國畫家康斯特勃（John Constable）誕生 250 週年，他 1821 年的名作《乾草車》（The Hay Wain）在伊普斯威奇的 Christchurch Mansion 展出。時機很微妙——英國正被熱浪烤著，評論說這幅被無數次複製的田園風景，如今讀起來像「氣候危機時代的傑作」：它提醒我們自然世界的美，以及我們可能失去的東西。同一週，Tate Modern 推出古巴裔美國藝術家 Ana Mendieta 的大型個展，她從新石器時代遺跡汲取靈感的作品既原始又詩意。音樂那頭，Bon Jovi 在主唱 Jon Bon Jovi 聲帶手術後重返紐約麥迪遜廣場花園，一場塞滿金曲的演出，被評「意外地動人」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 至 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 藝文這邊，一週有三件事。英國畫家康斯特勃誕生兩百五十週年，他的名作《乾草車》在伊普斯威奇展出。時機很微妙——英國正被熱浪烤著，評論說這幅一八二一年的田園風景，如今讀起來像氣候危機時代的傑作：提醒我們自然的美，和我們可能失去的東西。同一週，泰特現代推出藝術家 Ana Mendieta 的大型個展。音樂那頭，Bon Jovi 在主唱聲帶手術後重返麥迪遜廣場花園，演出被評為意外地動人。
